# Garment cutout fixtures

Six generated test photos cover a hanger, flat lay on a patterned background, mannequin, hands holding a garment, an intentionally edge-cropped coat, and a patterned blazer in a crowded closet. They are synthetic evaluation fixtures, not user photos. See `manifest.json` for the case list.

Run `npm run eval:garment-fixtures` with `REPLICATE_API_TOKEN` set to produce full-frame masks, transparent cutouts, and an original/mask/cutout contact sheet under `tests/garment-eval/`.
